NpcDesc: Peppy bursts onto the scene with boundless gusto, boosting the squad's On-Field and Off-Field Strength!
Wow, that diamond on Peppy's head is so sparkly! What? It's a gift for you? Quick, thank Peppy!
Peppy polished the two Emblems on their chest. The Emblems shine like stars in the sky.
Peppy polished the three Emblems on their chest. The Emblems shine like stars in the sky.
The thrilling battle is over! Your performance was so brilliant that Peppy has decided to break open its piggy bank and give you some shiny Gold Coins.
Well, look who it is! Peppy has arrived, wearing some fancy advanced equipment. End the battle perfectly, and it all belongs to you.
